note.title: Year 9 five-tense grammar synthesis
note.overview: Switch accurately among the five Year 9 test tenses and recognise their meanings.
learningGoals: Conjugate common verbs across the five tenses.
Choose the tense from the time meaning.
Prepare for the end-of-year grammar test.
workedExamples: je parle / j’ai parlé / je vais parler / je parlerai / je parlais
je vais / je suis allé(e) / je vais aller / j’irai / j’allais
commonMistakes: Choosing a tense from the English verb alone.
Confusing near future with present aller.
Using the perfect for a repeated past habit.
detailedExplanation: This topic is enabled because it is explicitly within the official Tiffin Girls’ School Year 9 French Curriculum Outline 2026-27.

The school outline verifies the curriculum scope and grammar focus but does not publish the teacher’s exact weekly vocabulary list. Context vocabulary here is standard French used to practise the verified scope, not an exact teacher-issued word list.
French accents are corrected and displayed, but a missing accent alone does not lose the mark in this app.
examTips: Underline the time clue before choosing a tense.
Check subject + verb, agreement, article choice and negative word order.
Answer the exact task before adding detail.
quickCheck: Conjugate common verbs across the five tenses.
Choose the tense from the time meaning.
Prepare for the end-of-year grammar test.
beforeStartingPractice: Read the note once, then answer from memory.
